task: Compute the sum of the list (list 2 3 5 7) using fold-right; store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned fold-right reverses the accumulator order, so (fold-right f 0 lst) sums left-to-right.

nodes.code: (let ((lst (list 2 3 5 7)))~~NL~~  (let ((acc 0))~~NL~~    (fold-right (lambda (x acc) (+ x acc)) 0 lst)~~NL~~    (rlm-set answer (fold-right (lambda (x acc) (+ x acc)) 0 lst))~~NL~~    (rlm-set Final t)~~NL~~    (final true)))
